Everyone knows that October to May is the period of seasonal strength. But there is more to seasonality than just that. October, November, and December all see mid-month "soft spots". Friday's selloff was part of the fulfillment of December's installment of that behavior.

It is also worth noting that some big news events in 2025 have knocked the market off its normal seasonal path, and then the market works to get back on the script after those improvisations. In October, it was a news event (Trump threatening China tariffs) that helped fulfill that mid-month soft spot. Same for the November selloff after the reopening of the federal government. AI fears are arising to fulfill December's soft spot.

I trade breakouts for one simple reason: they give me instant truth. 👇

1) Immediate Feedback
When a breakout triggers, I know within minutes or hours if the idea is right or wrong. No guessing. No waiting days for clarity. The market answers fast.

2) One-or-Zero Behavior
Breakouts either work or they don’t. If price holds above the breakout line, I stay. If it drops back below, I’m out. Clean. Binary. No noise.

3) Tight Stop Losses
Because the structure is so precise, my risk is small. A failed breakout cuts quickly. I don’t sit through days of sideways action or slow bleeding losses.

4) No Drifting, No Hoping
When I traded pullbacks, I needed wider stops, more patience, and more emotional tolerance. Many went sideways. Many drifted lower. And the losses became bigger.

5) Breakouts Match My Style
I want clarity, speed, precision. Breakouts give me structure. They tell me instantly when I’m wrong — and that saves both capital and confidence.

This is why I stick to them. Clean structure. Fast feedback. Small losses. And when they work… they move.

3 Moving Average Rules for Active Traders

#1) Let the 8 and 21 day moving averages guide your short-term approach.

When the SPX/SPY is above the 8 and 21 day moving averages, I want to stay long with a Portfolio Approach.

Depending on the particular trend, I’ll be long 10-35+ stocks, ETFs, and cryptos that show relative strength.

#2) Don’t fight stocks trending above the 8 & 21 day moving averages. Ride them!

Want to go broke really fast? Bet against a stock trending above the 8 & 21 day moving averages.

#3) When the SPX breaks the 8 & 21 day, Get Tactical.

That means I start selling longs, starting with names showing relative weakness, and anything I’m not completely bullish on.
